blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **перенести / переносить** — to transfer, to carry, to transport; (word) to carry over to the next line; to postpone, to put off; to extend. **привести / приводить** — to bring (someone with); to lead (of a road); to result, to lead, to bring; (mathematics) to reduce. **довести / доводить** — to lead, to take, to accompany (to), to bring (into); (cooking) to scald; to drive, to reduce, to bring, to carry. **завести / заводить** — to take, to bring, to lead; to get, to procure, to acquire, to buy; to establish, to set up, to found; to start. — DLI, Lesson 79.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: перенести / переносить — to transfer, to carry, to transport; (word) to carry over to the next line; to postpone, to put off; to extend.

exercises.why: The perfective aspect places the emphasis on the result of the action. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: The perfective aspect places the emphasis on the result of the action.

exercises.why: The verb **написать** is called perfective and expresses a single action with emphasis on its completion (either in the past or in the future, since the present tense deals only with actions in progress). — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
